verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud platform and its gcloud CLI, so the axis applies. However, no item in the evidence pack documents a telemetry, usage-reporting or tracking opt-out control. The cited docs cover CLI installation, APIs, IAM, billing, MCP servers and emulators, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
